events.name: New York Islanders at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Calum Ritchie had a goal and an assist on a pair of first-period power plays as the New York Islanders beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 3-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Calum Ritchie has early power-play goal and assist as Islanders top Maple Leafs 3-1

headlines.description: — Cole Caufield scored 4:38 into overtime as the Montreal Canadiens edged the Boston Bruins 3-2 in a rivalry matchup Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caufield’s 40th of season the winner as Canadiens top Bruins 3-2 in overtime

events.name: Carolina Hurricanes at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Charlie Coyle had a goal and three assists, Danton Heinen scored his 100th career goal and the Columbus Blue Jackets beat the Carolina Hurricanes 5-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Charlie Coyle's 4-point night leads the Blue Jackets to a 5-1 win over the Hurricanes

headlines.description: — Mats Zuccarello scored 3:09 into overtime, and the Minnesota Wild stopped a three-game slide by topping the Chicago Blackhawks 4-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mats Zuccarello scores in overtime as the Wild beat the Blackhawks 4-3

headlines.description: — Ryan O’Reilly scored the lone goal in the shootout to lift the Nashville Predators to a 4-3 victory over the Winnipeg Jets on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan O’Reilly scores in shootout as Predators edge Jets 4-3

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Edmonton Oilers

headlines.description: — Max Jones and Zach Hyman scored third-period goals, Adam Henrique had a pair of assists, and the Edmonton Oilers rallied without star forward Leon Draisaitl for an important 5-3 win over the San Jose Sharks on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Oilers rally past the Sharks 5-3 without Leon Draisaitl

headlines.description: — Elias Pettersson scored twice, including the 200th goal of his NHL career, and the Vancouver Canucks held on for a 5-2 win over the Florida Panthers on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Elias Pettersson scores twice to lead Canucks over Panthers 5-2

events.name: Buffalo Sabres at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen made 27 saves to record his first shutout of the season and the Buffalo Sabres defeated the Vegas Golden Knights 2-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luukkonen records first shutout of season as Sabres beat Vegas 2-0

events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Seattle Kraken

headlines.description: — Nikita Kucherov scored three goals for his sixth career hat trick and added two assists as the Tampa Bay Lightning beat the Seattle Kraken 6-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nikita Kucherov nets a hat trick and 2 assists as the Lightning beat the Kraken 6-2
